title: Applause
overview: Two teenagers encounter a rock that gives them the power to switch places with the clap of their hands. However, one of the boys struggles with bullying, relationship issues, and sexual identity as he tries to navigate the world as a young adolescent.

title: Babies
overview: Struggling with the decision of whether or not to bring a child into the world, Annie and her husband Aaron become instant co-parents when their newly-divorced friend moves into their home with her 4-year-old. An ensemble comedy drama about the journey to parenthood... or not.

title: Bollywoof
overview: A very British springer spaniel is lost in India, trying to find his human family. Basil the spaniel must team up with a streetwise Bollywood-obsessed street dog to survive.

title: Unholy Night
overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: Ghollak

original_title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

original_title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
overview: A woman struggles to find balance in her own relationship with nostalgia while unravelling the fate of a childhood friend who vanished after becoming consumed by it.

title: One Sweet Hour
overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

title: Little Flower
overview: An ominous dream pushes Layla, a directionless twenty-something to reconnect with an old friend.

title: When We Become Wind
overview: The third installment of Tux and Fanny

title: I promise I won't bore you.
original_title: I promise I won't bore you.
overview: Failing birthday clown and cam-star Mary wades through the messy world of T4T dating after being voted out from her polycule.

title: Friends Like Us
overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: The Virgins
overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: Kiwi Food
overview: Aboard Orbit International Rail, Phileas outruns his roots that hold him back, but with every passing landscape, he's pulled closer to the question he can't escape: where in the world does he truly belong?

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Hoodsteps
overview: This is the debut work of “Wosaka,” the globally popular character from the Republic of Tuktue, and the masterpiece of director Nomura Fusso, known as the ”father or mother of stop-motion animation.” The protagonist, Nomura, is an ordinary office worker at a company that manufactures adhesive bandages. One day, a face named Wosaka appears on the sole of her foot and starts moving around as it pleases. Wosaka puts on a suit, Nomura is forced to put on a shoe on her face, and they head to work upside down. As a result, the city descends into chaos! What is Wosaka’s purpose? Can Nomura return to normal?

title: Found Alive
overview: Reeve LeClaire is still haunted by when she was held captive as a teenager by a sadistic man, but when her psychiatrist asks her to mentor a newly rescued survivor, she’s pulled into a chilling game of cat-and-mouse—one that threatens to drag her back into the nightmare she barely escaped.

title: H.D.I.D.T.B.A.L.
overview: A woman has an existential crisis when she's asked out by a woman for the first time. What should she wear that shows her true self?

title: From the Ashes
overview: Two old buddies reunite to scatter the ashes of their friend and brother. Unbeknownst to them, they are soon to be visited by their late companion from beyond the grave.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Globe
overview: Globe is a cinematic folktale about identity, belonging, and resistance, set amid the tribal land struggles of Kerala. Seen through Kariyan, a young tribal boy, the film reflects the deep bond indigenous communities share with their land and the alienation they face in urban society. Rooted in Attappadi, the story subtly reveals ancestral dispossession and cultural erasure, urging reflection on justice, dignity, and the right to remain in one’s birthplace.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: Stuck! The Musical
overview: Dr. Atkins, the hospital's expert in removing "foreign objects", finds himself in a bind when he forgets to get a present for his big wedding anniversary. When the perfect gift presents itself inside a patient, will he risk it all for love?

title: Keys
overview: A woman returns to her ex's flat, where a quiet reunion begins to slip between holding on and letting go

title: Mr. Creamjeans' Hidey Hole
overview: Henry, a man plagued by chronic pain and unresolved guilt, receives a chilling message: "I know what you did." The note leads him to The Hidey Hole, an underground museum of erotic nightmares, curated by the charismatic and unsettling Mr. Creamjeans. There, Henry is offered a chance to erase all traces of his secret crime... but only if he submits to a guided tour of the museum's most depraved exhibits. With every tale, Henry's pain worsens and his grip on reality slips, until he's forced to confront the twisted role he's played in the lives (and deaths) of others. By the end, Henry must decide: confess the truth and face the consequence, or lose himself to the Hidey Hole forever.

title: Peculiar Green
overview: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: We Set the House on Fire
original_title: We Set the House on Fire
overview: Five strangers happen upon a mysterious house on New Years Eve, their secrets and connections begin to be uncovered as the night takes a supernatural turn.

title: Dead Drop
overview: A group of strangers board a freight elevator and find themselves trapped in an ever-worsening life-and-death predicament that ultimately reveals they are all linked together in a sinister, supernatural, or even biblical nightmare.

title: La Prospettiva [1653]
overview: Perspective and permanence inform Ben Russell’s playful La Prospettiva (1653), filmed in the Colonnade at the Palazzo Spada in Rome, capturing the central composition of the Baroque illusionism masterpiece but also modest moments of the labour  dedicated to its upkeep.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: Exit Only
overview: Cade hears about strange noises coming from one of his theater exits.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: Vintage Violence
overview: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Daughters of 9/11
overview: Twenty-five years after the deadliest terrorist attack on American soil, Elizabeth Miller, Jessica Trant and FBI special agent Frank Pellegrino confront whether the man accused of masterminding the attacks, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed (KSM), will ever face justice.

title: Censor Addiction
overview: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.

title: Forgotten Island
overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

title: Faux Amis
overview: Adele and May, two American twenty-somethings with different backgrounds and a less than sturdy friendship, travel together to Paris so that Adele can finally unite with the handsome Jacques, an (unbeknownst to the women) reclusive local there who has been courting Adele from across the Atlantic via Instagram. The city is not kind to their relationship.

title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
overview: The first ever WWE Sunday Night's Main Event takes place on Sunday, September 6, 2026, live from the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia during Labor Day weekend. The special television event streams live in the U.S. on Peacock starting at 8 p.m. ET.

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: Spiral
overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: Ithaqua
overview: During the decline of the fur trade, a mercenary struggles to unite the survivors of a famine-stricken outpost plagued by a dark force that leaves its victims with an insatiable hunger.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: Desert Fiends 2
overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: The Bigfoot Experiment
overview: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: Sea of Stars
overview: Driving through a sea of stars. The universe is infinite.

title: Blood Mandate
overview: A visceral action-thriller where a lone fighter is forced into a relentless pursuit by a grim ancestral decree. To satisfy a blood mandate that haunts his family's legacy, he must cut through a web of enemies and shifting alliances. As the hunt intensifies, the line between justice and revenge blurs in a raw struggle for survival.

title: Robotica
overview: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.

title: Donnie & Dude: Do Dudley
overview: When two stoners go on a journey from Sedgley to a charity shop in Dudley, they run into trouble with a sergeant, two rival stoners (Stupid caveman Chris and chill annoying Sam) and his special “Anti-Weed Task Force” (A.W.T.F) When they finally get a copy of a dvd from the charity shop, a mysterious evil character called “Gimp Man” comes to take it from them. With the help of samurai’s and good luck, they come out on top.

title: Larger than Life
overview: A documentary following Connor Sanderson, the inspirational coach of Salisbury Ladies FC. Born with sacral agenesis, Connor has overcome physical challenges to pursue his passion for football, becoming a respected coach and an inspiration to his players and community.

title: Salieri and Mozart
overview: A young gifted actor rehearses on his own when interrupted by the theater director and bizarrely mistreated. What will he make of it?

title: The Taking Tree
overview: A wicked tree terrorizes passersby, and there's only one man capable of ending its bloody killing spree.

title: Dead & Breakfast
overview: A paranormal consultant, Danielle Stanbreaker,  investigates a strange supernatural occurrence at a local Bed and Breakfast that ultimately ends up being real.

title: City of Angels
overview: Two best friends move to Los Angeles to chase their dreams, but when a fame-hungry ritual backfires, vengeful spirits seek them out and escaping may mean sacrificing everything they came for.

title: HANDMEDOWN
overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

title: Noise
overview: High from his rise to fame in an industry clamouring to promote him, a composer is privately challenged by his conductor. A film about how artists choose to defend their work, and where the blame falls if it all goes wrong.

title: George Michael: The Trojan Souls
overview: The conversation that never finished.  In 1993, Andros Georgiou — lifelong best friend and brother to George Michael — began assembling the greatest collaborative album ever conceived. Eight of the most iconic artists in history all said yes. The album was never made. Until now, the footage has never been seen. This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

title: Amerigo: The Search for the American Dream
original_title: Amerigo: The Search for the American Dream
overview: As the United States celebrates its 250th anniversary on July 4, 2026, AMERIGO: THE SEARCH FOR THE AMERICAN DREAM asks one urgent, unifying question – what happened to the American Dream – and explores if it is still attainable for many today. Filmed across all 50 states over two years, the program features unscripted interviews with everyday Americans, from blue-collar workers, veterans and immigrants to students, entrepreneurs and community leaders. Told in thematic chapters examining work, housing, healthcare, technology, art and more, AMERIGO captures a raw, panoramic and unexpectedly hopeful portrait of a country at a crossroads.

title: The Glorious Dead
overview: A small-town sheriff and her deputy awaken to a changed world where blood drips from taps, people and pets vanish, fleshy creatures roam the woods, and the hamlet descends into chaos. By noon, the skies turn white with snow, and the dirt cannot keep the dead down as the shattered community buckles under the pressure, and as the sun sets, all hell has frozen over.

title: KING
overview: King, a champion of the fighting organization, lives, trains, and fights under one roof with his roommate Sam. They compete weekly in grueling matches that leave them bruised and battered. Their landlord and promoter promises to get them away from this lifestyle for bigger and better opportunities on the condition that they continue to push themselves for another fight. The roommates face their toughest battles during recovery while pushing each other to continue training for their next bouts.

title: White Gardenia: The King James Bible
original_title: White Gardenia: The King James Bible
overview: An epic-scaled avant-garde underground project that will cover both the Old and New Testament, featuring segments from various filmmakers and their beautifully extreme visions of the myriad of biblical stories.

title: Homo Machina
overview: As a lonely man isolates himself, the line between the digital and physical world blurs.

title: Fake Hundreds
overview: After a cancer diagnosis, a man tries to confront God.

title: Something Borrowed
overview: On the morning of her wedding, a bride does anything it takes to fit into her wedding dress.

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

title: Amityville Alone
overview: Meet Ricky, an 8 year old boy neglected by his father. When Santa forgets to put his presents under the tree, Ricky gets granted three Christmas miracles by the Tree Witch. He wishes to be BIG, he wishes to be HOME ALONE, and finally, he wishes for his E.T.special friend Tito to go from being a dog to a full speaking humanoid. But once Ricky gets in trouble with a local gangster, he and Tito will have to fight for their right... to party!

title: Teeth of A Fawn
overview: Bea can’t breathe when her girlfriend’s away.

title: Sunlight Resonance
overview: A washed-up Hollywood actor wakes up amnesiac, fights through depression, addiction, and guilt.

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.

title: The Legend of Yella George
overview: A man's wife mysteriously goes missing one night. All evidence points towards the husband. As detectives dive deeper into the case, a local legend begins to twist itself into the case, confusing detectives and the husband. Nightmares, death, and mystery surround this story with an ending no one could see coming.
